notes.title: The Felicia Plushie is Here
notes.content:
It's been a long wait since we announced it, and an even longer wait since you got your Margaret plushes, but the Felicia plush is finally here!

[h1][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/felicia-banks-plushie]You can order yours at Makeship right now for delivery this March![/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642965/d6dd3f2a3d0f3c327a565668258c3dba61faee24.png[/img]

Just like last time, this is a limited run, so the next three weeks will be your only chance to order your plush!

And if you already have a Margaret plush, you can make them hold hands using their velcro patches! Now your OTP will never be apart again!

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

notes.title: The Margaret Plushie is for Sale!
notes.content:
[h1][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/margaret-de-campos-plushie]The Margaret de Campos Plushie is now available for sale at Makeship![/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642965/bbb8c5f844e293e6881d32f238bbbeddc84fc68f.png[/img]

For the next three weeks--now through Valentine's Day--you can order your own mouse girlfriend to take home!

Some of you might have already pre-ordered a plush during our initial, preliminary campaign, and those orders will still be honored, but for those of you who haven't had the opportunity to order, you can get yours now!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/margaret-de-campos-plushie]Order yours now for fulfillment in May of this year![/url]
